title: One Pan Tuscan Chicken and Potato Skillet
reject_reason: Creamy Tuscan chicken skillet (spinach, cherry tomato, parmesan, heavy cream) — same flavor identity as accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet; added potato does not change the dinner and the estate has already cut four Tuscan-cream chicken skillet variants.
